title: The first night
steps: The common room is very quiet, with a warm fire crackling in the fireplace and a round rug between two open arches.
These are the first-years' rooms. The girls sleep on the left, the boys on the right, and you will all share this common room.
Good night to both of you, and I will see you in the morning.
Goodnight, {wizard}. I am so sleepy! I will see you tomorrow.
{friend} walks through the arch on the left, heading into the other dormitory.
Now you are alone in the common room, and very tired. Your own warm bed is waiting for you through the arch on the right.
